task.title: Add horizontal alignment checks and audit facade
task.summary: Add first-class horizontal alignment checks under flat src/checks/** modules, with src/audit as the facade/tool surface and gateway evidence support.

goal.outcome: Gateway and audit can consume deterministic horizontal alignment evidence from flat src/checks/** modules while audit remains a facade/tool surface.
acceptance: Checks layer exposes horizontal KB↔KB checks for deterministic conflicting/stale/duplicate canonical claims.
Checks layer exposes code↔code checks for API/ownership/import-contract drift using source graph evidence.
Checks layer exposes KB↔code checks comparing documented paths/claims to source graph and task/build evidence.
Audit facade exposes the horizontal-alignment profile without owning low-level check implementation.
Gateway preflight/report can require and cite horizontal-alignment check evidence.
non_goals: Do not attempt unconstrained LLM semantic contradiction detection.
Do not block on low-confidence prose similarity alone.
Do not leave horizontal alignment implementation owned by src/audit/**.
verification: source search proves horizontal-alignment implementation lives under src/checks/** and audit is a facade.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Checks layer exposes horizontal KB↔KB checks for deterministic conflicting/stale/duplicate canonical claims.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/checks/horizontal-alignment.ts parses explicit horizontal_claims/alignment_claims frontmatter and reports kb-claim-conflict errors plus kb-claim-duplicate warnings; tests/smoke/horizontal-alignment.test.mjs covers pass, conflict, and duplicate cases.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Checks layer exposes code↔code checks for API/ownership/import-contract drift using source graph evidence.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/checks/horizontal-alignment.ts scans relative import/export/dynamic import contracts under src, handles TypeScript source backing .js runtime specifiers, includes .codewiki/index_graph.json as routing evidence, and reports code-import-target-missing; fixture tests cover missing imports.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Checks layer exposes KB↔code checks comparing documented paths/claims to source graph and task/build evidence.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Explicit doc code_paths, horizontal_code_paths, and horizontal claim refs are checked for missing source refs and generated read-model misuse; fixture tests cover kb-code-missing-source-ref.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Audit facade exposes the horizontal-alignment profile without owning low-level check implementation.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/audit/tool.ts imports auditHorizontalAlignment from ../checks/horizontal-alignment.ts; src/audit has no horizontal-alignment implementation module; src/checks/tool.ts exposes the checks-layer API.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Gateway preflight/report can require and cite horizontal-alignment check evidence.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: AUDIT_PROFILE_VALUES and Pi schema include horizontal-alignment; validation required_audits accepts arbitrary profile names, and docs/skills describe horizontal-alignment as selectable/required evidence.
tests/smoke/horizontal-alignment.test.mjs creates pass and fail fixtures covering pass, kb conflict, duplicate warning, missing KB-code ref, and missing imports.

closure_brief.user_intent: Implement TASK-051 after approved B: horizontal alignment belongs under flat checks layer and audit is a facade.
implemented_changes: Audit facade dispatches horizontal-alignment without owning the low-level implementation.
Added deterministic KB↔KB, KB↔code, and code↔code checks.
Added fixture tests and default smoke coverage.
Updated system docs/file-structure map and skill references.
remaining_risks: Pi /reload is required after commit before live audit command/tool schema accepts horizontal-alignment profile.
The first implementation intentionally covers explicit claims/refs and source import contracts; deeper semantic contradictions remain non-goal/future work.
